item.title: Why Is My Drip System Not Working?
item.description: You turn on your drip system and… nothing. Or maybe a weak trickle where there used to be a steady flow. Before you tear apart your entire balcony setup, work through this diagnostic sequence. Most drip system failures have simple causes with faster fixes than you expect. Quick diagnosis flowchart Start here and follow the path based on what you observe: No water anywhere in the system: → Check water source → Check timer → Check filter → Check main line
